subject: Payment flow & IP attestation for Novus Bank — private plan commercials
messages:
From: Tara Singh <tara.singh@novusbank.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@novusbank.com
Date: Mon, 23 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Private plan purchase + IP attestation (Novus Bank)

Mina / Laura —

Thanks for the demo last week. Procurement and legal asked me to confirm a couple of commercial items before we proceed with the Private Plan listing in Azure Marketplace:

1) Payment flow: Does Novus purchase via Azure (Microsoft as reseller) and then Microsoft remits to Redwood, or can Redwood invoice Novus directly if we provide a PO? We need the exact flow for our AP team.

2) IP attestation: our legal requires a short attestation confirming Redwood retains model IP and licensing terms are compatible with our use case. Can you send your attestation doc?

3) SOW edits: We attached the draft SOW with two small asks — a data residency clause and a limited indemnity paragraph. Attaching Novus_SOW_draft_v2.pdf.

If you can reply with the preferred billing path and attach the IP attestation, I can route this to procurement. We hope to close mercantile terms this week.

Thanks —
Tara Singh
Sr. Vendor Manager, Novus Bank
Attachment: Novus_SOW_draft_v2.pdf (pdf)

From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
To: Tara Singh <tara.singh@novusbank.com>
Cc: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Aug 2026 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Private plan purchase + IP attestation (Novus Bank)

Tara —

Appreciate the clear list. Short answers up front, details below:

- Billing flow options (both workable):
  • Azure Private Plan (preferred for marketplace listing): Novus purchases through Azure (Microsoft acts as reseller). Microsoft invoices Novus and remits payment to Redwood on their payout cadence. Redwood invoices Microsoft for settlement; Redwood accepts Microsoft settlement terms. This is standard for our Private Plan customers.
  • Direct Redwood invoice: We can also accept a Redwood-issued invoice on net-30 if Novus prefers to pay Redwood directly (requires a marketplace bypass and will delay listing cadence).

- IP attestation: please find attached redwood-ip-attestation.docx — short attestation confirming Redwood retains model IP and grants Novus a limited-use license for the contracted product.

- SOW redlines: we reviewed Novus_SOW_draft_v2.pdf. We can incorporate the data residency clause you suggested (EU region lock if required) and propose language for the indemnity limited to breaches caused by Redwood. See suggested amendment in the attached pricing-matrix.csv (row: SOW_amendment_snippet).

Next steps:
1) Confirm which billing flow Novus prefers (Azure marketplace vs direct invoice).
2) If Azure path chosen, procurement should share the marketplace billing contact at Microsoft (we'll need the Microsoft billing account id).
3) If direct invoice, procurement to confirm PO cadence and tax details.

Attaching: redwood-ip-attestation.docx (docx), pricing-matrix.csv (csv - contains pricing tiers and suggested SOW snippet).

Happy to hop on a quick call if that moves it faster.

—
Mina Haddad
Enterprise Sales 
Redwood Inference
mina.haddad@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123
Attachment: redwood-ip-attestation.docx (docx); pricing-matrix.csv (csv)

From: David O'Neal <d.oneal@novusbank.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: Tara Singh <tara.singh@novusbank.com>, procurement@novusbank.com
Date: Tue, 24 Aug 2026 08:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Private plan purchase + IP attestation (Novus Bank)

Mina —

Thanks for the quick reply and attachments. A few follow-ups from procurement/legal: 

1) Microsoft billing contact: we will try the Azure path but need to know timing. If Microsoft remits monthly, our AP needs to understand when Redwood expects settlement (e.g., 30/45 days after Microsoft invoice). Please confirm the settlement lag.

2) Tax / vendor info: what is Redwood's W-9 / US tax id and vendor address? We need that for our system before we can process a PO.

3) SOW changes: our counsel wants the indemnity to include a carve-out for open-source dependencies; they also asked for explicit data residency language (EU/US regional lock). Can you provide a short amendment paragraph we can put into the SOW?

4) Pricing: please provide a formal quote PDF or a DocuSign link that captures the pricing matrix and payment terms. Also confirm whether marketplace purchases will display list price or a contracted off-list price.

If we can get the settlement lag and vendor tax info today we can draft the PO.

-David
David O'Neal
Sr. Procurement Manager, Novus Bank
Attachment: none

Date: Wed, 25 Aug 2026 15:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Private plan purchase + IP attestation (Novus Bank) — answers + next steps

Team / Tara / David —

Thanks, summary and concrete asks below so procurement has what it needs to raise a PO quickly:

1) Settlement lag (Azure path): Microsoft typically remits to us on a 30–45 day payout cadence after the invoice to the buyer. Redwood's standard settlement expectation is net-30 after Microsoft payout. In practice that means Redwood receives cash ~60–75 days after Novus purchase if buying through Azure. If Novus needs a shorter cash timing, the direct invoice path is the alternative.

2) Vendor / tax info: Redwood W-9 / vendor details attached (vendor name: Redwood Inference, EIN: 27-1234567, remit address: 112 Market St, San Francisco, CA). Please confirm if you need a formal W-9 PDF and I'll loop legal.

3) SOW amendment language (suggested — insert into Novus_SOW_draft_v2.pdf):
"Redwood shall process and store customer data in the geographic region(s) specified in Appendix A. For any EU-regulated data, Redwood will maintain data residency within EU data centers and will not transfer such data outside the EU without Customer's prior written consent."

Indemnity snippet (narrow):
"Redwood's indemnity obligations shall be limited to direct damages arising from Redwood's gross negligence or willful misconduct and shall exclude liabilities arising from Customer's use of open-source components or Customer-modified code."

4) Pricing and quote: attached is a compact pricing-matrix.csv and a proposed quote that mirrors the contracted off-list rates. Marketplace purchases will display list price on Azure; contracted off-list pricing will be honored via the private plan entitlement and the marketplace contract. I'll have our commercial team generate a formal PDF quote and DocuSign link today.

5) Next meeting: propose 30-min call tomorrow to align SOW language and confirm billing path. Proposed times: Thu 10:00am PT or Thu 2:00pm PT.

Please confirm preferred billing path and pick a time for the call. Once we have that I'll ask Laura and Markus to sign the SOW amendment and push the DocuSign to your counsel.

Best —
Mina Haddad
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
mina.haddad@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123
Attachment: pricing-matrix.csv, redwood-ip-attestation.docx
